arguments.message:
Your next invoice will be generated on the billing date that appears in **Settings → Billing → Plan** next to “Next invoice.”

- This date is the same day of the month as when your workspace’s subscription originally started or last renewed.
- If your billing date is the 31st, the invoice will be issued on the last day of any shorter month.

Because the card charge occurs on that date, swapping the card a day or two before the listed billing date is enough for the new card to be used for the upcoming invoice.
